fields.name: Baku Higher Oil School
fields.description: Baku Higher Oil School (BHOS) is a leading technical university in Azerbaijan, established in 2011 by BP and the State Oil Company of Azerbaijan (SOCAR). It offers world-class engineering and business programs in collaboration with Heriot-Watt University.

fields.name: Azerbaijan State University of Economics (UNEC)

fields.name: Baku State University

fields.name: Azerbaijan Technical University

fields.name: ADA University

fields.name: Qafqaz University

fields.name: Istanbul Technical University
